ex.en: I have an aversion to crowded places.
ex.zh: 我很討厭人擠人的地方。

ex.en: Many investors have an aversion to risk.
ex.zh: 許多投資人厭惡風險。

ex.en: Some of my friends are strongly averse to AI.
ex.zh: 我有些朋友非常排斥 AI。

ex.en: I'm not averse to working late if needed.
ex.zh: 必要的話，我不排斥加班。

averse.en: strongly not liking or not wanting something

ex.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
ex.zh: 這位航空專家詳細分析了統計數據。

ex.en: He has worked in the aviation industry for 20 years.
ex.zh: 他在航空業工作了二十年。

aviation.en: the flying of aircraft, or the business of making and flying them

ex.en: On average, I watch two films a month.
ex.zh: 我平均每個月看兩部電影。

ex.en: Japanese women get married at 25 on average.
ex.zh: 日本女性平均二十五歲結婚。

average.en: the number you get by adding values and dividing by how many there are

ex.en: What is the average height of the players?
ex.zh: 選手們的平均身高是多少？

ex.en: The average price of a house here is very high.
ex.zh: 這裡的平均房價非常高。

average.en: calculated by adding values and dividing by how many there are

ex.en: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
ex.zh: 一般人一分鐘眨眼幾次？

ex.en: He is just an average student.
ex.zh: 他只是個普通的學生。

ex.en: Our sales average 200 units a day.
ex.zh: 我們平均每天賣出兩百件。

ex.en: The temperature averages 30 degrees in July.
ex.zh: 七月的平均氣溫是三十度。

average.en: to reach a typical amount over a period of time

ex.en: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
ex.zh: 我們天一亮就起床，以避開塞車。

ex.en: Avoiding a problem isn't going to help you solve it.
ex.zh: 逃避問題無助於解決問題。

ex.en: He loses his temper so easily that everybody avoids him.
ex.zh: 他很容易發脾氣，所以大家都躲著他。

avoid.en: to stay away from something or stop it from happening

ex.en: The road was closed because of an avalanche.
ex.zh: 那條路因雪崩而封閉。

ex.en: Skiers should check the avalanche warning first.
ex.zh: 滑雪的人應該先查看雪崩警報。

avalanche.en: a large amount of snow sliding quickly down a mountain

ex.en: We received an avalanche of emails after the launch.
ex.zh: 產品上市後，我們收到大量電子郵件。

ex.en: The store faced an avalanche of complaints.
ex.zh: 這家店面臨排山倒海的客訴。

avalanche.en: a sudden very large amount of things arriving at once

ex.en: He avenged the murder of his father.
ex.zh: 他對殺父兇手進行了報復。

ex.en: He avenged his father's death.
ex.zh: 他為他父親的死報仇。

ex.en: You killed my father. Today I will avenge him.
ex.zh: 你殺了我父親，我今天要為他報仇。

avenge.en: to hurt someone in return for harm they did to you or someone close to you

availability.zh: （房間、商品等）可供使用的情況

ex.en: Availability may vary by region and device compatibility.
ex.zh: 實際提供內容可能因地區與裝置相容性而異。

ex.en: Please check room availability for next weekend.
ex.zh: 請查一下下週末有沒有空房。

availability.en: whether something can be got or used

ex.en: Are you available for a call this afternoon?
ex.zh: 你今天下午有空通個電話嗎？

ex.en: I'm sorry, Mr. Lee isn't available right now.
ex.zh: 抱歉，李先生現在不方便接聽。

ex.en: Miss, are there any available rooms for tonight?
ex.zh: 小姐，今晚還有空房嗎？

ex.en: There is a position available for a secretary.
ex.zh: 有一個祕書的職缺。

ex.en: There are many jobs available in the computer industry.
ex.zh: 電腦產業有很多工作機會。

available.en: able to be got or used

ex.en: The hotel is on a wide avenue lined with trees.
ex.zh: 這間飯店位於一條兩旁種滿樹的寬闊大道上。

ex.en: We walked down the avenue to look at the shops.
ex.zh: 我們沿著大道走，逛著兩旁的商店。

ex.en: Talking to a counselor is one avenue worth trying.
ex.zh: 與諮商師談談是值得嘗試的一個途徑。

ex.en: The company is exploring new avenues for growth.
ex.zh: 公司正在尋找新的成長途徑。

ex.en: The driver turned quickly to avert an accident.
ex.zh: 司機迅速轉彎以避免意外。

ex.en: Talks were held to avert a strike.
ex.zh: 為了避免罷工，雙方進行了協商。

ex.en: She averted her eyes from the screen.
ex.zh: 她把視線從螢幕上移開。

ex.en: He averted his gaze and said nothing.
ex.zh: 他別開目光，什麼也沒說。

ex.en: She is an avid reader who finishes a book every week.
ex.zh: 她是個狂熱的讀者，每週讀完一本書。

ex.en: He is an avid fan of the local baseball team.
ex.zh: 他是本地棒球隊的狂熱球迷。

ex.en: My uncle is an avid gardener.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是個熱愛園藝的人。

ex.en: Tax avoidance is legal, but tax evasion is not.
ex.zh: 合法節稅是可以的，但逃稅不行。

ex.en: His avoidance of the subject made her suspicious.
ex.zh: 他迴避這個話題讓她起了疑心。

ex.en: Avoidance of sugary drinks can improve your health.
ex.zh: 避免含糖飲料能改善你的健康。

ex.en: I spread mashed avocado on my toast this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上在吐司上抹了壓成泥的酪梨。

ex.en: An avocado is ripe when it feels slightly soft.
ex.zh: 酪梨摸起來稍微軟的時候就熟了。

ex.en: We tried everything to fix the car, but to no avail.
ex.zh: 我們什麼辦法都試過想修好車，但都沒用。

ex.en: His apologies were of little avail to the angry customers.
ex.zh: 他的道歉對憤怒的顧客沒什麼幫助。

ex.en: Visitors can avail themselves of free Wi-Fi in the lobby.
ex.zh: 訪客可以使用大廳的免費無線網路。

ex.en: She availed herself of the chance to study abroad.
ex.zh: 她把握機會出國留學。

ex.en: Avian flu has caused problems for farms in many countries.
ex.zh: 禽流感讓許多國家的農場傷透腦筋。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of avian fossils.
ex.zh: 這間博物館有大量鳥類化石的收藏。

ex.en: The young aviator dreamed of flying across the ocean.
ex.zh: 那位年輕的飛行員夢想著飛越大洋。

ex.en: An early aviator landed his small plane in a field.
ex.zh: 一位早期的飛行員把他的小飛機降落在一片田野上。

ex.en: I changed my avatar to a picture of my cat.
ex.zh: 我把頭像換成了我家貓的照片。

ex.en: In the game, you can design your own avatar.
ex.zh: 在這款遊戲裡，你可以設計自己的虛擬角色。

ex.en: In the old story, the god came to earth as the avatar of a lion.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，那位神以獅子的化身來到人間。

ex.en: The leader was seen as the avatar of hope for the people.
ex.zh: 這位領袖被視為人們希望的化身。

ex.en: She reads avidly and finishes about two books a week.
ex.zh: 她很愛讀書，一個星期大約讀完兩本。

ex.en: The fans avidly followed every game of the season.
ex.zh: 球迷們熱切地關注這季的每一場比賽。

ex.en: Most accidents are avoidable if people are careful.
ex.zh: 只要小心，大部分意外都是可以避免的。

ex.en: The delay was completely avoidable.
ex.zh: 這次延誤完全是可以避免的。

ex.en: She is an avowed fan of classical music.
ex.zh: 她公開承認自己是古典樂迷。

ex.en: His avowed goal is to finish the race in under four hours.
ex.zh: 他公開宣告的目標是在四小時內跑完比賽。

ex.en: Sales averaged about two hundred units a day last month.
ex.zh: 上個月的銷量平均每天約兩百件。

ex.en: She averaged seven hours of sleep each night this week.
ex.zh: 她這星期每晚平均睡七小時。

ex.en: The coach had an avuncular way of giving advice.
ex.zh: 那位教練給建議時有種長輩般的和藹。

ex.en: He gave the nervous boy an avuncular smile.
ex.zh: 他對那位緊張的男孩露出和藹長輩般的微笑。
